mechanism.claim: When BTC perpetual quote turnover accelerates unusually from the first to the second four-hour half, realized variation is elevated, open interest expands, and the completed eight-hour price return is nonzero, broad participation and fresh leveraged inventory sponsor the completed price direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed eight-hour BTC perpetual return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCVAIR uses within-cycle quote-turnover acceleration plus exact OI expansion and variation, with completed price direction only after participation is established. Existing turnover/backloading candidates omit exact OI sponsorship; HVCFAR used signed aggressive-flow acceleration and failed source. HVCVAIR reuses neither event set nor control and uses no taker-flow sign, spot source, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour accelerating-turnover plus OI-sponsored states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.completed_cycle: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows with nonnegative quote_asset_volume over [D-8h,D)
features.half_turnovers: sum quote_asset_volume separately over first and second 240-minute halves; both strict positive
features.turnover_acceleration_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.completed_return: sum of 480 one-minute log(close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact coherent completed perpetual cycle, positive turnover acceleration, nonzero completed return, two exact OI endpoints with strict expansion, and both turnover-acceleration and variation ranks pass at D; no taker-flow sign, spot source, funding, range, premium-index, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC plus quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or expansion rule, turnover acceleration formula, acceleration or variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
